description: This file contains validation functions for form inputs in the vtiger CRM application, including checks for empty fields, pattern validation (email, date, time), date comparison, integer validation, and datetime validation. It is used to ensure that user input conforms to expected formats before submission.

methods.name: qcemptyCheck(fldName,fldLabel, fldType)
methods.description: Checks if a form field is empty based on its type. Alerts user if validation fails.

methods.name: qcpatternValidate(fldName,fldLabel,type)
methods.description: Validates form input against patterns such as email, date, or time using regular expressions.

methods.name: qcdateValidate(fldName,fldLabel,type)
methods.description: Validates that a date input is correct and within valid ranges, including leap year checks.

methods.name: qcdateComparison(fldName1,fldLabel1,fldName2,fldLabel2,type)
methods.description: Compares two date fields to ensure chronological order based on specified type.

methods.name: qcintValidate(fldName,fldLabel)
methods.description: Validates integer input, ensuring numeric range and type correctness.

methods.name: qcnumConstComp(fldName,fldLabel,type,constval)
methods.description: Compares numeric field value against a constant with operators like less than, greater than, equal, etc.

methods.name: qcdateTimeValidate(dateFldName,timeFldName,fldLabel,type)
methods.description: Validates date and time inputs, including leap year and range checks, and ensures chronological consistency.
